statement: Receiver USB bind in pinned xone does not pre-register gamepads for every wireless-client entry. After association creates a GIP adapter, GIP identification queues class registration and the gamepad class probe registers evdev input. Client adapter destruction unregisters its child devices, so re-association creates a new kernel input instance; any reuse of an evdev path number is not measured.
